name: Party Identification 340
definition: Provides information about the beneficial owner of the securities.

OwnerIdentification.name: Owner Identification
OwnerIdentification.definition: Party that is the beneficial owner of the specified quantity of securities.

DomicileCountry.name: Domicile Country
DomicileCountry.definition: Country in which a person is permanently domiciled (the place of a person's permanent home).

NonDomicileCountry.name: Non Domicile Country
NonDomicileCountry.definition: Holder of the security certifies, in line with the terms of the corporate action, that it is not domiciled in the country indicated.

OwnedSecuritiesQuantity.name: Owned Securities Quantity
OwnedSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Quantity of securities belonging to the beneficial owner specified.

CertificationType.name: Certification Type
CertificationType.definition: Type of certification which is required.

WithholdingTaxRate.name: Withholding Tax Rate
WithholdingTaxRate.definition: Requested percentage of a cash distribution that will be withheld by the tax authorities of the jurisdiction of the issuer, for which a relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

CertificationBreakdown.name: Certification Breakdown
CertificationBreakdown.definition: Provides additional information about the type of certification/breakdown required.
